test_downcast: test the tagbased_polymorphic module by calling create_zoo and verifying animal types and names
create_zoo: create a zoo of polymorphic animals including Labradors, Dogs, Chihuahuas, Cats, and Panthers
bark_dog: call bark on a Dog, Labrador, or Chihuahua instance to get its sound with name prefix
purr_cat: call purr on a Cat or Panther instance to get its purring sound string
set_dog_sound: set the sound attribute on a Dog instance to customize its bark output
